description: This file defines the GeneratorPooledCache class, which implements a pooled cache for an Orleans stream generator provider, managing message serialization, buffering, and eviction strategies.

classes.name: GeneratorPooledCache
classes.description: A cache for generator streams that utilizes object pooling, serialization, and eviction strategies for managing batch container messages.

classes.name: GeneratorPooledCache.Cursor
classes.description: An inner class implementing IQueueCacheCursor for iterating over cached messages.

methods.name: GeneratorPooledCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache components, including buffer pool, serializer, and eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Deserializes payload bytes into an object and creates a batch container.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns the sequence token associated with a cached message.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts a generated batch container into a cached message, serializing its payload.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a message payload into a buffer segment from the pool.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Constructs a StreamPosition object from a batch container.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch containers to the cache after converting them to cached messages.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge expired messages using the eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Creates a cursor for iterating over cached messages for a specific stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cache is under pressure; currently always returns false.
